question: Celebrated every year, the Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Award festival is named after the famous classical dancer of which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra** was a renowned **Odissi dancer **and **choreographer **from **Odisha**, India.
 
• The **Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Award **was established in his honor to recognize and promote **excellence** in classical dance forms.
 
• **Sri Ratikant Mohapatra,** the son and follower of Guru Mohapatra, established the Award in **1995.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a classical dance form from** Kerala,** India, known for its graceful movements and** expressive storytelling.**

 
 
• The name of the dance comes from** Mohini,** the Hindu goddess Vishnu's female **enchantress incarnation.**
 
 
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form from **northern India**, known for its intricate footwork and rhythmic patterns.
 
 
• This dance form is from **Uttar Pradesh.**
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi **is a classical dance form from** Andhra Pradesh,** India.
 
 
• It is known for its **dynamic movements** and **theatrical style.**
